thesis: Every claim needs its own measure, evidence level and refutation conditions.
role: Establish fair and statistically honest evaluation.

ideas.statement: Prediction, coherent generation, interventions and adaptation require separate metrics and held-out mechanisms, not just new samples.
Zero observed failures are not proof, and proof, enumeration and statistical detection support different guarantees.
Equal information access, full costs, component ablations and a claim register prevent unjustified generalization.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: For independent identical failure trials, zero failures gives an approximate 95 percent upper bound of 3/n for large n.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Repeated seeds do not replace structural variation, and failed search cannot prove nonexistence of a compact representation.
